product.name: Monoprice Consul Series USB-C VGA Adapter
product.description: Extend your reach and grasp new possibilities with your USB Type‑C® equipped computer using the Consul™ Series of USB‑C® adapters. Featuring USB Type‑C 3.1 functionality, the Consul Series is able to offer a variety of options to expand your ability to work anywhere.This Consul™ Series USB‑C to VGA Adapter allows you to connect an external VGA display to expand your system's desktop area or to mirror the main display, with support for VGA video resolutions up to 1920x1200@60Hz. It is a true plug and play device, requiring no additional drivers when used on a Windows® or macOS® computer. It draws all the power it needs from the USB‑C port, so no additional power adapters or connections are required or full functionality.
